objective: Execute the unchanged Round 15 paired fresh-container V6 contract after fixing only the zero-execution direct-file package import preflight failure.

allowed_change_from_round15.paired_runner: Add the workspace root to sys.path before importing envsolve when the file is executed directly.
allowed_change_from_round15.regression_test: Direct-file --help must exit zero and load the workspace package.
allowed_change_from_round15.forbidden: No target, image, bootstrap, fixture, timeout, snapshot field, normalization, comparison, decision, or retry change.

runner_contract.source: For each repetition, create a new local no-hardlinks detached checkout at the exact inherited revision without fetching or reading dirty worktree files.
runner_contract.cleanliness_gate: Require exact HEAD and tree identity plus an empty git status independently before each bootstrap.
runner_contract.container_git_gate: Add only /data/project to Git safe.directory inside each temporary container.
runner_contract.mount: Each repetition receives distinct source and control directories plus the EnvSolve policy tree read-only; no writable volume is shared.
runner_contract.external_fixture: Create only the preregistered collision-checked build_output directory in each temporary checkout.
runner_contract.bootstrap: Source the exact inherited frozen bootstrap in one persistent shell for each repetition.
runner_contract.network_transition: Allow network only during bootstrap; disconnect every Docker network before snapshot collection.
runner_contract.snapshot_collection: Collect Python runtime, full marker environment, complete canonical-name/raw-version installed-distribution multiset, and content-addressed project metadata/provenance.
runner_contract.snapshot_hash: Canonical JSON with normalized ordering and retained duplicates; independently recompute each declared SHA-256.
runner_contract.comparison: Require identical frozen identities and exact snapshot hashes; emit structured component multiset deltas on state drift.
runner_contract.temporary_storage: Use distinct host-platform temporary directories unless an explicit bind-mount-safe root is supplied.
runner_contract.cleanup: Always remove each container and temporary checkout after writing its raw replay artifact.

paired_replay_contract.ordering: Execute required replay A then required replay B for each target regardless of A outcome.
paired_replay_contract.independence: Require distinct container IDs, checkouts, control directories, and writable layers with zero shared writable volumes.

decision_contract.v6_pass: Both complete validated snapshots are hash-identical with no component delta.
decision_contract.v6_fail: Both snapshots are valid under the same identity but normalized state differs.
decision_contract.v6_unknown: Bootstrap/snapshot is missing, collection or source/network/hash evidence is invalid, a container ID is reused, or identities differ.

expected_causal_checks.online_resolution: Unpinned package-version drift must appear in installed-distributions deltas.
expected_causal_checks.project_state: Metadata/provenance drift must appear in project-distributions deltas.
expected_causal_checks.ephemera: Container IDs and timings may differ without causing state failure.
expected_causal_checks.infrastructure: A pre-snapshot failure leaves the pair unknown rather than pass or fail.
expected_causal_checks.official_outcomes: No official verifier runs and no official score changes.
